_note: Gate C evidence for the 1.7.0 release. Combo mode (Free+Pro 1.7.0, rail=standalone). Two real bugs found and root-caused this pass: (1) a role-granted vendor with no wpss_vendor_profiles row hits 'Vendor not found' instead of an empty-state profile - Journey 04's own precondition scenario. (2) Standalone offline checkout is a total dead end whenever the WP_DEBUG-only Test Gateway is also enabled, because OfflineGateway and TestGateway both emit a hidden field literally named wpss_gateway into the SAME shared form - proven by toggle (disabling Test Gateway makes the identical checkout succeed and correctly write payment_method='offline'). This plugin verifies runtime behaviour through audit/journeys/ rather than a click-script, so the journeys were the smoke rather than scaffolding a second system for the same job.

failures.triage_note: Root-caused to source. VendorService::get_profile() -> VendorProfile::get_by_user_id() returns null when the user has no wpss_vendor_profiles row (no synthetic fallback), and Shortcodes::vendor_profile() treats a null profile as 'Vendor not found.' rather than rendering templates/vendor/profile.php with its empty states. This is exactly the scenario Journey 04 step 3 names as the regression to guard against ('role-granted, legacy and demo-seeded vendors' - the plugin's own CLAUDE.md and wpss_vendor_status_block() explicitly call this class of vendor out elsewhere and handle it; this one surface does not). Reproduced with user 254 (appqa_seller): has the wpss_vendor role (wpss_is_vendor()=true) but zero rows in wpss_vendor_profiles.
failures.expected: Vendor profile page renders with empty states ('hasn't published any services', 'No reviews yet'), per Journey 04 step 3.
failures.actual: 'Vendor not found.' error message; the vendor never appears in the /vendors/ directory grid either (VendorService::get_all() only returns rows that exist in wpss_vendor_profiles), so this is a completely dead profile page for any role-granted vendor without a profile row.
failures.screenshot: not captured (headless text confirmation only); reproducible via GET request

failures.triage_note: Root-caused and proven by toggle. OfflineGateway::render_payment_form() (OfflineGateway.php:458) and TestGateway::render_payment_form() (TestGateway.php:224) both emit <input type=hidden name="wpss_gateway" value="...">. StandaloneCheckoutProvider (lines 1044-1057) renders EVERY enabled gateway's render_payment_form() output into the SAME <form>, only hiding non-selected ones with CSS display:none - so both hidden fields are submitted together regardless of which radio the buyer picked, and the browser's form serialization keeps only the last-rendered gateway's value (rendered order was Stripe, Offline, Test - so 'test' always won over 'offline'). Buyer selected Offline Payment, filled billing, clicked Pay: got 'An error occurred. Please try again.', and the admin-ajax POST (action=wpss_offline_process_payment) came back as a 302 redirect into an unrelated wp-admin WooCommerce settings screen (403 for the buyer) rather than any JSON response - the exact mechanism producing that specific redirect was not fully traced beyond the field collision, but causation is proven: with wpss_test_gateway_settings temporarily set to enabled:0, the IDENTICAL checkout (same order, same buyer, same billing, Offline Payment selected) succeeded immediately and wpss_orders.payment_method correctly recorded 'offline'. TestGateway is gated 'Only available when WP_DEBUG is enabled' per its own docblock, and WP_DEBUG=true on this environment - meaning this bug is live on every WP_DEBUG dev/staging/QA box, which includes the box this release-gate smoke runs on. Settings were restored to their original state (enabled:1) and order 53 reverted to payment_method=NULL after the toggle-proof.
failures.expected: Selecting Offline Payment and clicking Pay records wpss_orders.payment_method = 'offline', leaves status pending_payment, and shows the Payment Instructions (Journey 06 step 5).
failures.actual: 'An error occurred. Please try again.' banner; console error 'Checkout error: SyntaxError: Unexpected token <, <!DOCTYPE... is not valid JSON'; network shows admin-ajax.php returning a 302 to http://wss.local/wp-admin/admin.php?page=wc-settings&tab=checkout&section=wpfi_woo_order_test, which 403s for the buyer. Order stays pending_payment with payment_method=NULL - the exact 'dead end, not just cosmetic' failure mode the journey's own commit history was written to prevent.
